preconditions.description: k must be within the range from 1 to n.
n must be within the range from 1 to 10^9.

postconditions.expression: result == sorted([str(i) for i in range(1, n+1)])[k-1]
postconditions.description: The result must be the k-th smallest number in the lexicographical order of numbers from 1 to n.
